content.value: A company is negotiating a single sampling acceptance sampling plan. It has been decided 10 that the customer can live with a lot tolerance percent defective equal to 0.20 as long as the alpha risk is 0.10. The supplier decided that they can accept a beta risk of 0.005. If the average quality level is 0.03, during production of lots of size 4000. Find the most appropriate sample size and acceptance number using the binomi'al nomograph.
